description: This file declares interfaces for managing process containers, including abstraction for network interfaces, memory, CPU information, container lifecycle operations, and an administrator singleton for container creation and management within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over network interfaces of a container, providing methods to get interface name, number of addresses, and specific addresses.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface providing memory usage statistics such as allocated, resident, and shared memory in bytes.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface providing CPU usage metrics including total CPU time, per-core usage, and number of cores.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Interface to iterate over container instances, mainly providing access to container IDs.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Represents a process container with methods to retrieve its ID, PID, memory, CPU info, network interfaces, and control methods to start and stop the container.

classes.name: IContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton interface for managing container creation, retrieval, and logging configuration.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance with specified parameters; returns an IContainer pointer.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all created container IDs.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID; may return nullptr if not found.

ctags.name: IContainerIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/

ctags.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class INetworkInterfaceIterator : public Core::IIterator,  public Core::IReferenceCounted  {$/
